g.text: Address decoding selects one target; each target exposes registers or memory.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Address, data, and control buses connect a processor to memory and peripherals

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Conceptual memory-mapped bus. Separate vertical paths denote separate address/data/control signal bundles, not shorted wires at crossings. Read data
travels back toward the CPU; writes travel toward the selected target. Interrupts, arbitration, wait states, DMA, and serial pins are omitted.
